test_category_namespace_discovered: test that category-namespaced plugins like image_gen/openai are discovered with the correct path-derived key
test_flat_plugin_key_matches_name: test that flat plugins keep their bare name as the registry key for backward compatibility
test_depth_cap_two: test that plugins nested three levels deep are not discovered by the scanner recursion
test_category_dir_with_manifest_is_leaf: test that a category directory with its own manifest stops recursion and ignores children
test_valid_kinds_parsed: test that valid plugin kinds (backend, exclusive, standalone) are correctly parsed from the manifest
test_unknown_kind_falls_back_to_standalo: test that unknown plugin kinds fall back to standalone with a warning log message
test_user_backend_still_gated_by_enabled: test that user-installed backend plugins require opt-in via enabled config and are not auto-loaded
test_user_backend_loads_when_enabled: test that user-installed backend plugins load successfully when explicitly enabled in config
test_exclusive_kind_skipped: test that exclusive kind plugins are recorded but not loaded, with an error message indicating the reason
test_bundled_image_gen_openai_autoloads: test that bundled backend plugins like image_gen/openai auto-load without any opt-in configuration
